edges.reason: msg.sender determines the privileged-owner bypass branch and all caller-specific checks inside mint().
The caller address is passed to isWhitelisted, so whitelist admission is entirely caller-controlled.
mint() reaches _safeMint which performs an external call to the recipient, transferring control before state is fully settled.
The ERC721Receiver callback re-enters mint() while the loop and accounting are still in progress.
The user-supplied _mintAmount is multiplied by cost to derive the required payment.
_mintAmount drives the loop bound that repeatedly calls _safeMint.
mint() executes the unchecked-by-design per-iteration counter increment.
The accounting increment is keyed on the caller-supplied msg.sender, so limits are per-spoofable-identity.
The increment writes into the addressMintedBalance state mapping used for limit enforcement.
mint() reads nftPerAddressLimit to enforce the per-address mint cap.
mint() branches on the pausable state variable before any minting logic.
mint() reads cost as a multiplier for the required payment value.
mint() reads maxMintAmount to bound the per-session mint volume.
mint() compares supply + _mintAmount against maxSupply, an untrusted-influenced sum.
mint() delegates its whitelist admission decision to isWhitelisted.
isWhitelisted linearly scans the owner-controlled whitelistedAddresses array.
setCost is gated by onlyOwner and mutates the payment-critical cost state variable.
setNftPerAddressLimit is gated by onlyOwner and mutates the per-address cap used in mint().
pause is gated by onlyOwner and toggles the mint circuit breaker.
setOnlyWhitelisted is gated by onlyOwner and toggles mint admission mode.
whitelistUsers is gated by onlyOwner and arbitrarily rewrites the whitelist array.
reveal is gated by onlyOwner and irreversibly writes the revealed flag.
setmaxMintAmount is gated by onlyOwner and mutates the session mint cap.
tokenURI reads baseURI to build the returned metadata location.
tokenURI branches on the owner-controlled revealed flag to decide which URI to return.
tokenURI returns notRevealedUri while the collection is hidden.
tokenURI appends baseExtension to build the final metadata string.
setNotRevealedURI is gated by onlyOwner and rewrites the placeholder metadata URI.
setBaseExtension is gated by onlyOwner and rewrites the metadata suffix.
msg.sender is evaluated by the onlyOwner modifier guarding whitelistUsers.

normalization_plan.reason: _mintAmount is a mint() parameter; its semantics are fully captured by the mint function node.
supply is a transient local cache of totalSupply() inside mint() and adds no independent semantics.
ownerMintedCount is a local snapshot used for the same accounting flow as the addressMintedBalance increment.
_user is only the lookup argument of isWhitelisted and should be folded into that function node.
the loop counter i only drives the mint loop and should be folded into the mint function node.
